name: 5 min away
summary: A 25 second whack-a-mole built from the chat's running joke about the friend who's always 5 minutes away, with a crew leaderboard.
useWhen: a group with a running joke about one friend (always late, always 'omw')
'make a game out of this', 'someone bonk Theo', a gaming tab for a friend group
dontUseWhen: a game everyone plays at once in real time

params.title: string
params.early: the friend who's already there (don't bonk)
params.place: sign on the awning, e.g. Brunch 11:00
